premises.text: Digital media creation for games and film remains mostly manual, driving very high time and cost
premises.evidence_span: The $80 billion video game industry spends on average 61% of their project budgets on digital media creation. The reason is that it's still an almost entirely manual process

premises.text: Artomatix example-based AI generates controllable artistic content across images and 3D data while keeping the artist in the loop
premises.evidence_span: Artematics is an example-based way of making art. That means you give the computer an example of something you want, and it makes more

premises.text: Video games are the beachhead market, with Artomatix Cloud SaaS expanding to the broader industry
premises.evidence_span: we've identified that video games are our beachhead, and we've already achieved significant traction in this space

premises.text: Monetization is a software-as-a-service business model
premises.evidence_span: We're going to monetize through a software-as-a-service business model

premises.text: Core IP is controlled and protected through patents and trade secrets
premises.evidence_span: we control all of the IP, and we're protecting it through a combination of patents and trade secrets

value.text: Cut digital art time and cost while expanding creative variety for artists and games
value.evidence_span: Our goal is to half the time and half the cost of this process through automation

secondary_value.text: Richer game worlds with much greater variety of generated content
secondary_value.evidence_span: We can take gaming to the next level. Imagine a world hundreds of times larger than you've ever seen before

causal_links.evidence_span: we solve the problem that art costs too much and it takes too long
We have built an artificial intelligence system that can mimic human-like artistic creativity
Artomatix Cloud, which can address the entire industry, big to small
